```{r include=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)

#import data
rls <- read_csv('../Data/rls_m1_tasmania.csv')


```


```{r}

# create summary to see what to filter on 

rls_summary <- rls %>%  
  separate(survey_date, c('year', 'month', 'day'), sep='-', remove=FALSE) %>% #create a year column
  group_by(species_name) %>% 
  mutate(n_obs = sum(total), year_min = min(year), year_max = max(year), n_year = n_distinct(year), n_survey = n_distinct(survey_id), n_size_class = n_distinct(size_class)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  unite(year_span, year_min, year_max, sep = "-", remove = TRUE) %>% 
  distinct(species_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  select(species_name, n_obs, year_span, n_year, n_survey, n_size_class)



```
What filtering requirements to use? I want to look at change over time, so 


```{r}
# filter 
rls2 <- rls %>%  
  separate(survey_date, c('year', 'month', 'day'), sep='-', remove=FALSE) %>% #create a year column
  group_by(species_name) %>% 
  mutate(n_obs = sum(total), year_min = min(year), year_max = max(year), n_year = n_distinct(year), n_survey = n_distinct(survey_id), n_size_class = n_distinct(size_class)) %>% 
  filter(n_obs >= 200) %>% 
  filter(n_year >=10) %>% 
  filter(n_size_class>= 3) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(species_name!='Unidentified fish (baitfish)') %>% 
   filter(species_name!='Arripis spp.') %>% 
   filter(species_name!='Arripis trutta') %>% 
   filter(species_name!='Cephaloscyllium laticeps') %>% 
   filter(species_name!='Pseudocaranx georgianus') %>% 
   filter(species_name!='Trachurus declivis') %>% 
  filter(species_name!='Urolophus cruciatus')

```

```{r}
table(rls2$species_name)
```

```{r}
## random code
uncount(total, .remove = FALSE) 
```

```{r}
ggplot(rls2, aes(size_class ))+geom_histogram()+facet_wrap(.~species_name, scales = 'free')
  
```

```{r}
rls2 <- rls2 %>% group_by(species_name, size_class) %>% 
  mutate(n_per_size_class=n()) %>% 
  ungroup()
```
```{r}
ggplot(rls2, aes(size_class, n_per_size_class))+
  geom_point()+
  facet_wrap(.~species_name, scales = 'free')
```
